name: Compute Cluster S65: Range-Based Volatility Estimation
description: Tests: volatility_estimator(type, period, trading_periods), ulcer_index(period). Garman-Klass, Parkinson, Yang-Zhang. OUTPUT SCALE: decimal fraction (0.20 = 20%).
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S65: Volatility Estimation
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
open_p = src.o
high = src.h
low = src.l
close = src.c

# === GARMAN-KLASS (default) ===
vol_gk = volatility_estimator(period=21, trading_periods=252)(open_p, high, low, close)

# === PARKINSON (high-low only) ===
vol_pk = volatility_estimator(type=VolatilityEstimatorType.parkinson, period=21, trading_periods=252)(open_p, high, low, close)

# === YANG-ZHANG (handles gaps) ===
vol_yz = volatility_estimator(type=VolatilityEstimatorType.yang_zhang, period=21, trading_periods=252)(open_p, high, low, close)

# === ULCER INDEX ===
ui = ulcer_index(close, 14)

# === VOL REGIME DETECTION ===
vol_fast = volatility_estimator(period=14)(open_p, high, low, close)
vol_slow = volatility_estimator(period=60)(open_p, high, low, close)
vol_expanding = vol_fast > vol_slow

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Realized Vol: GK vs Parkinson vs Yang-Zhang (21d)',
    category='Volatility',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Garman-Klass', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Parkinson', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Yang-Zhang', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(vol_gk, vol_pk, vol_yz))

xy_lines(
    title='Ulcer Index (14d)',
    category='Volatility',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Ulcer Index', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=ui)

xy_lines(
    title='Vol Regime: Fast (14d) vs Slow (60d)',
    category='Vol Regime',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Fast Vol', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Slow Vol', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(vol_fast, vol_slow))
